⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: Roomba runs for 1–2 minutes, stops with a red ring light, and says 'Error 26: Please inspect and clean Roomba's vacuum path' even after you put in a brand-new HEPA filter.

Verified technical root cause: Fine dust or moisture has seized the bearings inside the 20N636P010 vacuum impeller fan motor inside the dustbin (900 series) or cleaning head module (e/i/j series).

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Remove the dustbin and filter, then try spinning the small black plastic fan impeller blade inside the vacuum motor port with a cotton swab: if it feels gritty or won't spin freely, the 20N636P010 fan motor is seized.
  2. Unscrew the top cover of the cleaning head (or dustbin on 960/980) and plug in the 2-pin 20N636P010 replacement blower motor.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Error 26 (Low Airflow) / Error 2 (Clear Brushes))

What causes Roomba Error 26 right after washing the dustbin?
On Roomba 800 and 900 models, the 20N636P010 fan motor is built directly into the dustbin—rinsing that bin under a faucet corrodes the motor bearing overnight.
